targets.old_statement: Youth needs extra sleep, apnea multiplies nod risk sevenfold, and night or sixty hour weeks multiply it nearly sixfold.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Youth needs extra sleep, apnea multiplies nod risk sevenfold, and night or sixty hour weeks multiply it nearly sixfold.
targets.statement: People sixteen to twenty-four often need more sleep than average adults, untreated obstructive sleep apnea raises the risk of falling asleep at the wheel seven times, working the night shift raises that risk by nearly six times, and rotating-shift or over-sixty-hour weekly workers must be particularly careful.

targets.old_statement: Rumble grooves roar pull off orders to fading drivers, while illness, drugs and stormy moods order handing keys over before rolling.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Rumble grooves roar pull off orders to fading drivers, while illness, drugs and stormy moods order handing keys over before rolling.
targets.statement: Running over a shoulder rumble strip requires pulling off at a safe place immediately to check alertness; when unwell, let someone else drive; avoid alcohol and sedating medications by checking labels or asking your doctor; and when strong emotions affect driving, cool off off-road, leave extra time, or let someone else drive.
